`store` seeds pre-existing entries, embedded for real so the prefilter behaves as it does live. `message.text` is the candidate. `expect` is the verdict.

Expectations here were chosen deliberately, not assumed. Two subjects that share vocabulary are not automatically the same subject: `docker networking` absorbing bridge-vs-host detail is clear, but a NAT-latency fact and a macOS-VM-architecture fact are arguably distinct, so no case asserts those must merge. Cases where the right answer is genuinely debatable are left out rather than encoded as truth.
